$description: VIPTV design tokens. Dark-only UI. One accent (user-selectable). Values come from the redesign canvas; bracketed notes mark proposals.

bg.$description: App ground. OLED mode swaps it for #000000.

1-pressed.$description: Phone pressed step of a surface-1 card (continue card).

avatar.$description: Ground behind avatar and profile images.

primary.$description: Titles, labels, off-white fills (selected segment, TV focus).

tertiary.$description: Captions, hints, placeholders. Never below 12 px.

on-light-secondary.$description: Secondary text on an off-white (TV focused) fill: "· Current", times.

on-light-accent.$description: "Best match" eyebrow on an off-white (TV focused) source row.

light.$description: Text on off-white fills (selected segment, TV focus, light pill).

default.$description: Primary action, progress, spinners, caret, best-match label. Exactly one accent primary per screen.

danger-on-light.$description: Destructive text on an off-white (TV focused) fill.

spinner-on-accent.$description: Spinner track inside an accent (primary) button.

strong.$description: Selected chip border, focused field border.

on-accent.$description: Divider inside an accent split button.

tv-selected.$description: TV chip selected but not focused.

glass.$description: Phone floating nav (with 20 px backdrop blur).

white.$description: Pure white: light-pill hover (D), toggle knob, TV focus ring.

light-pressed.$description: Light pill pressed; TV button pressed (OK held).

wash.$description: Hover wash for outline / quiet / chip (D); TV source row unfocused.

wash-pressed.$description: Phone outline pressed; desktop section-nav hover.

tag.$description: "Required" tag, toast Dismiss button, TV source quality block.

tv-field.$description: TV text field, keyboard key and PIN box fill.

scrollbar.$description: TV full-screen text panel scroll bar.

on-accent-hover.$description: Hover of one half of an accent split button.

on-light-badge.$description: Quality badge / block on an off-white (TV focused) fill.

live-glass.$description: LIVE glass badge and glass back button over art.

watching-badge.$description: TV WATCHING badge over a still.

notice-glass-tv.$description: Player notice pill and preparing panel (TV).

popover-glass.$description: Player track popup / playback info card.

dot.$description: Inactive carousel dot on the ground.

dot-over-art.$description: Inactive carousel dot over art (desktop hero).

glass-button.$description: Round glass button over art (desktop poster hover "+").

grabber.$description: Phone bottom-sheet grabber (40 x 5); same grey as the spinner track.

cue-glass.$description: TV manage-profiles pencil cue on an unfocused tile.

profile-letter.$description: Letter avatar ground for a profile without an avatar image (PhProfiles / DeskProfiles "cedes").

overflow-disc.$description: Phone touch-overflow ⋯ disc over poster art (PhOverflowCue).

dialog.$description: Desktop dialogs/drawers (body row only; title bar + rail stay bright).

tv-fullscreen.$description: TV full-screen text entry / text panel.

card-hover.$description: Desktop card hover: art dims to 0.38.

card-actions.$description: Bottom stop of the desktop poster-hover action gradient (top stop is transparent).

ground.$description: Skeleton shape on the app ground.

card.$description: Skeleton shape inside a surface-1 card.

shimmer.$description: Skeleton shimmer highlight (off under reduced motion).

empty.$description: Desktop guide block without guide data ("No guide data — watch live").

upcoming-text.$description: Title of an upcoming desktop guide block (upcoming blocks use surface-1).

empty-tv.$description: TV guide block without guide data.

back-desktop.$description: Desktop player Back disc over the picture (DeskPlayer).

control-hover.$description: Desktop player control hover (CmpDesk3 left group).

control-active.$description: Player control pressed / its popup open (aria-expanded), P and D.

shade.$description: Player top shade start (D/T); the bottom shade ends transparent at the top.

shade-end-desktop.$description: Desktop player bottom shade at the edge.

shade-end-tv.$description: TV player bottom shade at the edge.

up-next.$description: Up Next card fill on desktop and TV (phone uses fill.popover-glass).

display.$description: Titles, wordmark, monogram logos. Google Fonts, opsz 12–96, wght 500–800. "Bricolage Grotesque Variable" is the family name the bundled @fontsource-variable package declares (tv-web).

ui.$description: All UI text. Google Fonts, wght 400–700.

mono.$description: URLs, file names, playback-info values, pairing codes (display font on TV).

screen-title.$description: Tab screen titles (Discover, Live TV, My List).

button-detail.$description: Primary button on the title detail (58 tall).

dialog-title.$description: Phone bottom-sheet title ("Sign out of this device?", "Choose a source").

group-label.$description: Phone settings group label above a card ("PLAYBACK", "ACCOUNT").

subpage-title.$description: Phone sub-page and card title ("Sign in to viptv", "Edit profile", "Find your favorite").

player-title.$description: Phone player header title (wraps to two lines).

page-title.$description: Page H1 (Discover, Live TV, My List, Settings).

monogram.$description: Channel monogram on a desktop live tile.

nav-label.$description: Desktop settings section-nav group label ("THIS DEVICE").

card-title.$description: Sign-in card title on web and the desktop app ("Sign in to viptv").

device-code.$description: Pairing code in the sign-in "Use another device" panel.

app-mark.$description: "V" app mark on the 44 px sign-in tile (phone and desktop).

player-title.$description: Desktop player header title (one line, ellipsis).

mono.$description: Playback info values, error details (desktop / web).

min.$description: Nothing on TV is smaller than 18 px.

field-large.$description: TV search field value; PIN keypad digits.

entry.$description: TV full-screen text entry value (96 tall).

status.$description: TV player status words: PLAYING / PAUSED / BUFFERING / LOADING.

keycap.$description: TV key-legend keycap label ("OK", "BACK", "▲ ▼"). Glyph chips, aria-hidden.

list-row.$description: TV 80 px list rows: panel actions, settings rows, choice rows.

description-title.$description: TV description panel / section heading at 40 ("Maximum quality").

app-mark.$description: "V" app mark on the 52 px TV pairing tile.

monogram.$description: Channel monogram on a TV still (320 × 180); the desktop live tile's 30 scaled to the TV tile.

radius.$description: Pill rule: any pill-shaped control uses radius = height ÷ 2.

3xl.$description: Phone cards/sheets rows, TV rows/panels items.

sheet.$description: Phone sheet top corners, featured card.

avatar.$description: Avatars are rounded squares: radius = 20% of size.

2xs.$description: Desktop quality badge, kbd keycap, text-link focus ring.

sm-plus.$description: Desktop menu / choice rows, quality block (D), TV legend keycap.

xl-plus.$description: Toasts, phone source rows, backend banner, TV fields.

sheet-top.$description: Phone bottom-sheet top corners (as drawn on every phone sheet).

app-mark.$description: App mark tile ("V"): radius = 30% of its size (sign-in 44 → 13, TV pairing 52 → 15).

qr.$description: QR code tile: radius = 12.5% of its size (TV pairing 360 → 45, sign-in panel 108 → 13).

space.$description: 4-based with the 2/3/5/6/10/14 half-steps the screens actually use.

min-target.$description: Every tappable target is 44 px or more.

bottom-clearance.$description: Scroll padding so content clears the floating nav.

sheet-top.$description: Top gap above a tall (list) bottom sheet.

sheet-bottom.$description: Bottom inset under a bottom sheet (home indicator).

note.$value: Tiles keep fixed widths; wider windows show more tiles. Never stretch low-res art.

panel-pad-right.$description: TV right panel padding, right (safe area).

panel-pad-bottom.$description: TV right panel padding, bottom (room for the key legend).

pill.$description: Light pill, empty-state action, phone outline dropdown (P/D).

split-chevron.$description: Width of the chevron half of the desktop split button.

row-nav.$description: Desktop section paging chevron discs beside "See all" (WebSearch, DeskHome shelves).

tv-entry.$description: TV full-screen text entry field height.

choice-desktop.$description: Choice / radio / menu row min height (D).

menu.$description: Popover menu row / track popup row min height (D).

small.$description: Progress bar on small tiles / live rows (P/D).

phone-round.$description: Icon inside an icon-only round button (phone).

desktop-round.$description: Icon inside an icon-only round button (desktop).

tv-round.$description: Icon inside an icon-only round button (tv).

xs.$description: Check-badge check, poster-hover Play pill icon (P/D).

tv-small.$description: Chevrons in TV chips and settings rows.

banner-tv.$description: Glyph inside the 72 TV backend-panel disc.

inline.$description: Spinner inside a button or source row (P/D).

badge.$description: Dot inside the LIVE glass badge.

small.$description: Clear-search disc (P/D search field), desktop popup close.

phone-bottom.$description: Phone toast bottom offset (above the nav).

notice-height.$description: Notice toast / player notice pill height (P/D).

height.$description: Desktop kbd keycap height (min width too).

tv-height.$description: TV text / search field caret height (3 px wide).

width.$description: Phone episode row still (series title page; no phone series reference: 16:9 at the row's 72 height).

height.$description: Phone episode row still (series title page).

hover-action.$description: Play pill height and round "+" in the desktop poster hover actions.

pencil-cue.$description: TV manage-profiles pencil cue (top-right of every tile).

focus.$description: Focused / error field border; best-match source row.

strong.$description: Active PIN box, radio ring, dashed add-profile tile (P/D), TV outlines.

tv-strong.$description: TV dashed add-profile tile, TV lock badge ring.

glass.$description: Backdrop blur: phone nav, player popups.

badge.$description: Backdrop blur: glass badges and back button.

ambient.$description: Desktop Home hero ambient fill: the hero art blurred behind the hero (DeskHome, WebHome, WideHome).

tv.$description: Quality badge and solid LIVE block height (TV).

pill.$description: UP NEXT / WATCHING pill badge height (P/D).

radio-dot.$description: Inner dot of a checked radio (20 ring).

tv-width.$description: TV full-screen text panel scroll bar width.

tv-thumb.$description: TV text panel scroll thumb default length (scaled to content by the owner).

bar.$description: Airing progress bar at the bottom of a desktop guide block.

bar-tv.$description: Airing progress bar at the bottom of a TV guide block.

play-phone.$description: Phone Play / Pause accent disc (PhPlayer, CmpPhone3).

tool-phone.$description: Phone tools row buttons (audio, subtitles, info, fullscreen); also popup rows.

play-desktop.$description: Desktop Play / Pause accent disc; the controls row height.

up-next-desktop.$description: Up Next card width, desktop (bottom-right, above the timeline).

overlay-top-tv.$description: TV player notice pill and Up Next card top (TvPlayerBuffering, TvUpNext).

bottom-tv.$description: TV player info + timeline + controls block, distance from the bottom edge.

seek-room-tv.$description: Room above the TV timeline for the seek bubble while seeking (TvPlayerSeek).

desktop.$description: :focus-visible only. Off-white ring with a 2 px ground gap. Never accent.

desktop-hover-card.$description: Card hover: inset ring (never an outline that the card clips) + art dims to 0.38 + accent play disc.

tv-fill.$description: Buttons/rows: off-white fill + 4 px white ring + lift. Exactly one focused element per TV screen.

tv-ring.$description: Image tiles: ring + scale; caption shifts 8 px and brightens.

phone.$value: none — pressed state (surface step + scale 0.97) replaces hover/focus.

tv-shadow.$description: Machine value of the TV focus ring + lift used by focus.tv-fill and focus.tv-ring.

tv-scale-button.$description: TV buttons, pills and chips retain their size on focus (focus.tv-fill).

tv-scale-row.$description: TV full-width rows retain their size on focus.

tv-scale-tile.$description: TV image tiles retain their size on focus (focus.tv-ring).

tv-caption-shift.$description: TV focus brightens captions without moving them.

tv-scale-key.$description: TV on-screen keyboard and PIN keypad keys retain their size on focus.

tv-caption-shift-profile.$description: TV profile names brighten without moving on focus.

desktop-card-inset.$description: Desktop keyboard focus drawn inside a clipped card (poster / continue art): off-white ring + ground gap, inset.

tv-shadow-block.$description: TV focus on a guide block (off-white fill, ring, lower lift).

focus.$description: Focus fill/ring/scale transition (desktop ring and TV focus). Proposed by the tv-web foundation step.

toast-error.$description: Errors carry Dismiss (startup error: Try again).

pressed-scale-row.$description: Pressed scale for full-width rows (choice, source rows) on phone.

pressed-scale-card.$description: Pressed scale for cards (continue card, stills).

marquee-delay.$description: Pause before an overflowing TV line starts to travel (Roku ScrollingLabel; player title).

up-next-tick.$description: Up Next countdown tick; the countdown bar eases over one tick.

pressed-scale-control.$description: Pressed player control (desktop / phone transport and tools, CmpDesk3).
